How to beat loneliness
when you live alone
Build a weekly routine with people in it. A Tuesday football game, a Thursday class, a Sunday call with family. Fixed social moments keep loneliness away.
Say yes to small invitations. Coffee with a colleague, a neighbour's barbecue, a friend's birthday. Small yeses slowly build a real social life.
Get to know your neighbourhood. The same café, the same barber, the same gym. Being a familiar face makes a city feel like home.
Get a pet or help with one. A dog, a cat, even walking a neighbour's dog. Animals bring daily company and get you outside.
Fill quiet evenings with something good. I do five minutes a day of history, art or science, and it turns lonely moments into curious ones.
slides.texte_sophia: I do five minutes a day on a micro-learning app like the Sophia app. History, art, science. It turns lonely moments into curious ones.

slides.texte_overlay: Host something simple. Pasta for three friends, a film night, a board game evening. Inviting people is the fastest cure for feeling alone.
Talk about it with someone you trust. Many men feel lonely and say nothing. Saying it out loud is the first step to changing it.
